description:
[read-only] The newest test lead run on the form (or the run named by runId) that you started: status (creating, waiting, passed, failed), followUp or reason, a plain-language message, and whether the test lead was deleted from Meta. Needs ads:manage.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms/{formId}/test-lead.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

formId.description: The Meta Instant Form id (digits), from GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms.

name: ads_lead_form_test_lead_status
title: Read a test lead result
